sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 5.84 per unit (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
Your on-time delivery averaged 82.5% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70740@2026Q3, sc:70740@2026Q2, sc:70740@2026Q1, sc:70740@2025Q4).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We are unable to offer a fixed price for a 24-month contract, so we have added the AS-14404 index clause to your third option. 

Our main proposal is a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, in exchange for this index clause and your requested 60-day payment term, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.60 per unit, with a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your updated offer and the movement on your side. As a reliable distributor, we value our ongoing partnership and are always keen to support your business with our extensive material range and dependable service.

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Building on your third option with the 60-day payment term and the AS-14404 index clause, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is a significant step toward your target while respecting our operational limits.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued movement and are pleased to offer a further reduction to €5.40 per unit for the 60-day payment term and 24-month contract. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Regarding our operational limits, as a distributor we operate on tight margins that do not allow us to absorb unlimited cost pressure. Our margin and our limits stay internal. We believe this offer represents a fair balance for both parties and look forward to your agreement.

To confirm the full terms, our offer includes a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please keep in mind that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
